settings.question: How fast do I get a custom 10x15 tent?
settings.answer: Five business days from approved proof to ship — nationwide.

settings.question: When does a 10x15 make sense?
settings.answer: When you've outgrown a 10x10 but the venue can't fit a full 10x20 — it gives you more frontage and storage behind the booth.

settings.question: Do I see it before it prints?
settings.answer: Yes — a free digital proof, and no production until you approve.

settings.question: Will the print fade outdoors?
settings.answer: No. Dye sublimation bonds the ink into the fabric so it holds color in sun and weather.

settings.heading: Custom 10x15 Event Tent
settings.intro: The in-between size — more frontage and storage than a 10x10 without committing to a full double booth. Printed edge-to-edge and delivered in 5 business days. Free proof before you pay.
